records.title: Engineering readiness for synthetic J1–J4 review
records.scope: Engineering prerequisites for synthetic J1-J4 review: authorization/capability enforcement, J2 storage/OCR/quarantine/scanner, J3 concurrency/optimistic-locking, J4 A1 snapshots/artifacts/staleness, accessibility WCAG 2.2 AA, migrations, build integrity. Must pass before runtime approval button is enabled.
records.implementation_gate_reason: Engineering prerequisites (authorization, J2 storage/OCR, J3 concurrency, J4 artifacts, accessibility, migrations, build integrity) not yet implemented

checks.label: Capability matrix enforced in every view and service action; default-deny for organization/record/role/action
Django Storage abstraction for quarantine/protected documents; authorized download returns bytes; unauthorized returns zero bytes
Scanner adapter fail-closed: unavailable/error blocks processing; not advisory
OCR reads bytes from storage.open(opaque_key); failures visible and retryable; no silent swallowing
FieldProposal immutable from creation; FieldDecision append-only; one final decision per proposal; zero-field confirmation rejected
WorkerIdentityRevision created on confirmation; readiness reads authoritative revision
Optimistic locking on Worker and Assignment; two concurrent edits yield one success + one stale response
A1InputSnapshot and A1Artifact created per A1 case; bytes stored in protected storage
Deterministic A1 generation with fresh all-page preview QA; human visual validation mandatory
A1 internal states: draft/ready-for-review/generated/QA-passed/approved/stale/failed; source revision marks artifacts stale; issued/submitted never overwritten
WCAG 2.2 AA: axe-core automated pass; manual keyboard/focus/zoom/reflow/screen-reader checks
Forward-only migrations after 0007; MigrationExecutor transitions from 0005/0006/0007 on PostgreSQL
All pytest tests pass; manage.py check clean; makemigrations --check clean; git tree clean at approval time
checks.evidence: CI run or local pytest run
